definitions.explanation: A concentrated skincare product designed to target specific skin concerns such as wrinkles, dark spots, or dryness. Applied after toner and before moisturizer.

examples.japanese: {美容液|びようえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{美容液|びようえき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{保湿|ほしつ}→保湿：11617_hoshitsu⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This serum has a high moisturizing effect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{化粧水|けしょうすい}→化粧水：15802_keshousui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{美容液|びようえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}って→塗る：01174_nuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{乳液|にゅうえき}→乳液：16091_nyuueki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: After toner, apply serum and then lotion.

notes:
USAGE:
A key product in Japanese skincare routines. Japan has a detailed multi-step skincare culture, and {美容液|びようえき} occupies a specific place in the routine between toner (⟦{化粧水|けしょうすい}→化粧水：15802_keshousui⟧) and moisturizer (⟦{乳液|にゅうえき}→乳液：16091_nyuueki⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美容液|びようえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧ (to apply serum)
- ⟦{美白|びはく}→美白：16979_bihaku⟧{美容液|びようえき} (whitening serum)
- ⟦{保湿|ほしつ}→保湿：11617_hoshitsu⟧{美容液|びようえき} (moisturizing serum)
- {美容液|びようえき}⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧ (serum ingredients)
